data.desc: FreeCast, Inc. (NASDAQ: CAST) is a media technology company providing a software-based Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) designed to simplify entertainment discovery, distribution and monetization. FreeCast brings together free and premium streaming, live television, local programming, subscription management, advertising and commerce through a unified platform. Through its business-to-business-to-consumer (B2B2C) model, FreeCast enables telecommunications providers, internet service providers, satellite operators, broadcasters, property operators, membership organizations and other enterprises to offer branded media experiences while maintaining direct customer relationships.
